clarityGauges.parameterName: Turbidity, water, unfiltered, monochrome near infra-red LED light, 780-900 nm, detection angle 90 ±2.5°, formazin nephelometric units (FNU)

limitations: Not calibrated: the rain-decay curve is heuristic, so no range is stated.
One value for the spot: creek backs and open water are not told apart.
clarityVisibility.provenance: Rain-decay estimate from MRMS rain over the surrounding area, 0.01 in in 72 h.
